title: Ample invertible module on a scheme (absolute ampleness)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $n\ge0$ write $\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$ for the $n$-fold tensor product $\mathcal L\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\dots\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] (with $\mathcal L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_X$); it is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module. For a global section $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ put $X_s=\{x\in X:\ s_x\notin\mathfrak m_x(\mathcal L^{\otimes n})_x\}$, where $s_x$ is the germ of $s$ in the stalk $(\mathcal L^{\otimes n})_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and $\mathfrak m_x$ the maximal ideal of the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$; equivalently, $X_s$ is the set of points where the value of $s$ in $(\mathcal L^{\otimes n})_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\kappa(x)$ is nonzero ($\kappa(x)$ the residue field [def-weil-residue-field]). The set $X_s$ is open in $X$ (Stacks Modules Lemma 01CY; the invertibility of $\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$ and the openness of $X_s$ are the statements recorded in `pointers`), and $X_s$ is viewed as an open subscheme of $X$. $\mathcal L$ is *ample* if (1) $X$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and (2) for every $x\in X$ there exist $n\ge1$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ such that $x\in X_s$ and $X_s$ is an affine open of $X$ [def-pc-scheme]. This is the absolute notion of Stacks Properties Definition 01PS (EGA II 4.5.3).

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks Properties Section 01PR and Definition 01PS (properties.tex 4229-4257; EGA II 4.5.3 is its reference) and Modules Lemma 01CY (modules.tex 4360, lemma-s-open) and 01CT (4201, lemma-constructions-invertible); tags verified in tags/tags (01PR, 01PS, 01CY, 01CT, 01HW, 01IJ, 01K2, 005A). The definition agrees with 01PS (quasi-compact X; every point in an affine X_s for a section s of some L^{otimes n}, n >= 1). Changes: (a) the claim 'X_s is an open subset' moved out: the definition now names it only in words and records in `pointers` the existing reviewed node lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes (Stacks 01CY) and, for the invertibility of L^{otimes n} which 01CY needs, lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor (1) (Stacks 01CT (1)); neither is in stmt_deps; (b) stmt_deps: def-weil-finite-type-morphism removed (it is the morphism notion, not the quasi-compactness of a scheme) and replaced by the new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme (CompactSpace); new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-affine-scheme (IsAffine/IsAffineOpen) added for 'X_s affine'; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk added for the germ s_x in (L^{otimes n})_x; (c) the sentence contrasting with def-sc-ample moved to the field `note` (it cited a node that is not a dependency). No proof hints or bold tag references in the text. The five citers (lem-weil-pbc-coherent-twist-global-generation, -formal-systems-graded-vanishing, -vanishing-projective, -projective-ample-invertible, -ample-scheme-separated) use exactly conditions (1) and (2) (quasi-compact X, affine X_s for sections of powers n >= 1) and the X_s notation; none needs a change. Mathlib: no ample invertible module (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, grep recorded; Mathlib has no invertible-module/Picard API in AlgebraicGeometry/Modules); the source repository's IsAmple is the very-ample-power notion over a field.
